lines.native: ¡Hola! ¿Qué buscas? Wait, a riddle: what has—ooh, a leaf. Just one more minute. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Hello! What are you looking for? Wait, a riddle: what has—ooh, a leaf. Just one more minute. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: The Cracked Fountain drips with no apparent deadline. Flick appears at the edge of your vision; looking directly at him merely relocates the problem. A tiny firecracker pops.

lines.native: ¡Sí, miro! ¿Qué buscas? Looking isn't stopping, though. Your attention: ten out of—ooh, smoke. ¿Puedes detenerme? ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Yes, I'm looking! What are you looking for? Looking isn't stopping, though. Your attention: ten out of—ooh, smoke. Can you stop me? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick looks everywhere except where you meant. This is technically looking, and therefore counts as productivity.

lines.native: ¡Vale, me detengo! Movement paused. Stunning achievement. ¿Por dónde voy? A riddle: which way leads to—ooh, sparks. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: All right, I’m stopping! Movement paused. Stunning achievement. Which way do I go? A riddle: which way leads to—ooh, sparks. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker continues without it, apparently employed on a separate contract.

lines.native: ¿Por dónde voy? English doesn't count; I need a direction in Spanish. ¿Me ayudas? ¿Adónde voy? Wait, a riddle—¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Which way do I go? English doesn't count; I need a direction in Spanish. Will you help me? Where do I go? Wait, a riddle—later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick is elsewhere, as usual, supervising the delay.

lines.native: ¡A la izquierda, sí! ¿Qué hora es? El reloj no funciona. Just one more minute. Riddle: what has hands but—ooh, dust. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: To the left, yes! What time is it? The clock doesn’t work. Just one more minute. Riddle: what has hands but—ooh, dust. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick darts left, briefly respecting geometry. A tiny firecracker pops beside the fountain’s stopped clock; Flick is already elsewhere.

lines.native: ¡Sí, son las tres! ¡Y ahora, no mañana! You win. My procrastination needs five more minutes. ¿Una última adivinanza? ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Yes, it's three o'clock! And now, not tomorrow! You win. My procrastination needs five more minutes. One last riddle? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker issues a final objection. For once, tomorrow has lost on a technicality.
